importMarkdownSubtitle: A zip package or a single .md file
importSpecEntries: Every .md file at the top level of the zip is one entry; a single .md file also works.
importSpecAssets: Put images, videos and audio under assets/ (subfolders allowed) and reference them with relative paths.
importSpecFrontMatter: An optional front matter at the top may set title, time, mood, category, tags, weather and position. Without it, the title comes from the first level-1 heading or the file name, and the time from a date at the start of the file name.
importSpecRoundTrip: Markdown exported by this app without merging can be imported back directly; merged single-file exports are not supported.
